purpose: Illustrative media-library assets; not client portfolio work.

assets.prompt: Create a minimal, elegant 3D editorial product illustration for a Brazilian creative agency's media library demo. A single simple unbranded matte warm-yellow ceramic coffee mug (#FEC200), perfectly cylindrical body, thick rounded circular handle, no taper, no saucer, empty. Off-white seamless background (#F5F5F3), soft diffuse studio light, subtle short shadow, restrained off-white and yellow palette only, no dark or saturated backgrounds. Soft clay-render appearance with realistic ceramic shape, clean contemporary design. NO text, lettering, logos, people, characters, icons, interface, borders, collage or watermarks. Landscape 16:9 image. This is part of a coherent series showing exactly the same generic yellow mug. SHOT 1: hero product view. The complete mug centered, handle to the right, eye-level three-quarter angle slightly above the rim. Product occupies about 50% of frame width with ample negative space. Only mug and shadow on seamless off-white ground.
